description: This file defines the class ParameterListTable, which extends JTable to display and interact with parameter data related to ECU configuration. It manages cell rendering and editing, especially for combo boxes representing units, and provides tooltips based on parameter descriptions.

classes.name: ParameterListTable
classes.description: A specialized JTable for displaying ECU parameter data with custom rendering, editing, and tooltips.

methods.name: ParameterListTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with a model, disabling header reordering, and setting column sortability.

methods.name: getCellRenderer
methods.description: Returns custom cell renderer, replacing the default with a combo box renderer for specific cell types.

methods.name: getCellEditor
methods.description: Returns custom cell editor, replacing the default with a combo box editor for specific cell types.

methods.name: getToolTipText
methods.description: Provides a tooltip with the parameter description if available for the row under the mouse event.

methods.name: displayComboBox
methods.description: Determines whether a cell should display a combo box based on its data type and properties.

methods.name: setColumnSortable
methods.description: Sets whether a specific column is sortable in the table's row sorter.
